description: Prompts used to evaluate the writing-style skill. Each is generated twice (with the skill as a system prompt, and as a baseline with no system prompt), then scored by check.py.

cases.prompt: Write a short internal email announcing that the team is switching from Jira to Linear next month.
Write two paragraphs of a blog post about why businesses need to adopt new technology to stay competitive.

Rewrite this so it sounds like a real human wrote it: 'In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, organisations must leverage cutting-edge technologies to seamlessly navigate the complexities of modern business. It is important to note that a holistic approach can yield extraordinary results.'
Write a two-line Slack message asking a colleague if they can review your pull request before end of day.
Write a short farewell message to a teammate who is leaving the company after four years.
Write a three-sentence executive summary of a quarterly sales report that shows 12% revenue growth and a new record month in March.
Write the opening paragraph of a job description for a senior backend engineer at a fintech startup.
Write a reply to a customer who reported that the export feature has been failing for two days. Acknowledge the issue, explain it's fixed, and apologise.
Write a short internal announcement that the new analytics dashboard is live and where people can find it.
Write speaker notes for a one-minute opening to a conference talk about how a small team shipped a feature in a week.
